basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group. Research interests in LLM reasoning, VLM hallucination, and LLM truthfulness.

work.summary: Research intern at Tencent WXG, advised by Zifei Shan.
Research intern at Shanghai AI Lab, advised by Prof. Yu Cheng.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

publications.name: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
publications.summary: We introduce SynLogic, a framework for synthesizing verifiable reasoning data at scale to improve logical reasoning in large language models and beyond.

publications.name: On the Perception Bottleneck of VLMs for Chart Understanding
publications.summary: We investigate the perception bottleneck of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for chart understanding tasks.

publications.name: On the Universal Truthfulness Hyperplane Inside LLMs
publications.summary: We discover a universal truthfulness hyperplane inside large language models and explore its implications for LLM truthfulness and interpretability.

publications.name: In-Context Sharpness as Alerts: An Inner Representation Perspective for Hallucination Mitigation
publications.summary: We propose using in-context sharpness as alerts from an inner representation perspective for hallucination mitigation in large language models.

publications.name: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models
publications.summary: We introduce C-Eval, a comprehensive multi-level, multi-discipline Chinese evaluation suite for foundation models.

publications.name: Composing Parameter-Efficient Modules with Arithmetic Operations
publications.summary: We explore composing parameter-efficient modules with arithmetic operations for efficient model adaptation.
